title: Hide Concepts From Sketchpad Kit App UI
description: Remove CONCEPTS from the sketchpad kit app UI - diagram view, table view, toolbar filters, detail panel, selection/hover handlers. Ensure they are not rendered, selectable, or interactable anywhere in the app.
summary: Removed all concept UI from the Kit app in sketchpad. 3 edits in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx: (1) Removed concept Action chips from both mobile and desktop Kit table rows. (2) Removed selectedConcepts-based table filtering that hid design rows not matching concept GUIDs. (3) Removed concepts from useKitAppSelectAll so concepts are never programmatically selected. Already clean from previous work: KitDiagramNodeKind, ArtifactKind, KitKindToggles, KitCreateActions, buildKitDiagramData kindGroups, visibleGuids, diagram hover/selection handlers, detail panel sections, artifactKinds breadcrumb, isKitDiagramNodeKind guard. Internal concept infrastructure preserved for data management. All 105 unit tests pass, 21 elements/ui tests pass, Vite production build succeeds.
